notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one experience counter.
Note: the starting mana prerequisite is reduced if you start with additional experience counters.
description:
Cast Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying at most {2}{R}{R}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of Seething Song and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
